title: Membership Billing Note: Tailwise Plus Renewals, Declined Fees and the Past-Due Grace Period
content:
**Product:** Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus — paid tiers (Tailwise Plus Monthly, Tailwise Plus Annual, Tailwise Plus Premier Annual).

**Retired clauses.** The clause under which a paid tier charged its membership fee on each next billing date while auto-renewal is on, and the clause under which paying the overdue fee reinstated the paid tier for the same term dates, are both **no longer in force**; they have been superseded by the current basis for those charges.

**Renewal dates.** An annual tier's next term starts the day after the current term's end date.

**Declined fee.** A declined fee is retried for the tier's retry days (calendar days). Then the membership goes past due and, because no tier continues benefits while past due, loses free shipping, perk credit use and points earning until reinstated.

**Grace period.** The overdue fee is paid no later than the tier's grace days after the membership went past due. The grace period is counted in calendar days from the day the membership went past due — the date of the declined-fee entry on the rewards history — and a payment on the last day of the grace period is in time. Where the overdue fee is not paid within the grace period, the paid tier lapses to the free tier earned by spend.

**Late fees.** No late fee is ever charged.

| Went past due (hypothetical) | Grace days of the tier | Last day the overdue fee is in time | One day later |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 April | 30 | 1 May | 2 May — the paid tier lapses |
| 3 March | 14 | 17 March | 18 March — the paid tier lapses |

**What the member loses while past due:** free shipping, perk credit use and points earning — all three return only on reinstatement.

superseded_clauses: A paid tier charges membership_fee_usd on each next_billing_date while auto_renew is true;
Paying the overdue fee reinstates the paid tier for the same term dates;
